goal: Is ke baad aap aisa for loop likh sakenge jo ek block ko pehle se maloom dafa repeat karta hai, kisi bhi step mein upar ya neeche ginti kar sakenge, aur usey round by round trace kar sakenge.
warmup: Aap ki teacher kehti hain: 'Apna naam paanch dafa likho.' Aap har dafa ruk kar nahi sochte. Aap ginte hain: ek, do, teen, char, paanch, aur paanch par ruk jate hain. Aap ek number (1) se shuru hue, aap ne poocha 'kya main end tak pahunch gaya?', aap ne kaam kiya, aur ginti aage barha di. For loop bilkul yehi ginti wala tareeqa hai jo computer ke liye likha gaya hai. 'Welcome to PF' ko 100 dafa print karne ke liye loop ke baghair 100 lines chahiye hongi. Loop ke saath sirf teen.
definition: Loop code ke block ko repeat karta hai. For loop woh loop hai jo aap tab use karte hain jab aap ko pehle se pata ho ke kitni dafa repeat karna hai. Yeh apne teen control hisse ek hi line mein rakhta hai: initialisation (kahan se shuru karna hai), condition (kab tak chalna hai) aur update (kaise aage barhna hai). Body ke ek run ko iteration kehte hain.
howItWorks: Upar wali pipeline ko step by step chalayein. Order hamesha yeh hota hai: ek dafa initialise, phir condition check, phir body run, phir update, phir dobara check, aur aise hi aage. Update pehli body se pehle kabhi run nahi hota. Jab condition false ho jati hai, loop ruk jata hai aur program closing brace ke baad wali line se aage chalta hai. Kyunke check pehle aata hai, for loop zero dafa bhi run ho sakta hai: for (int i = 10; i < 5; i++) kabhi body mein nahi jata, kyunke 10 < 5 shuru se hi false hai. Tip: 1 se shuru karke i <= 5 paanch rounds deta hai. 1 se shuru karke i < 5 sirf chaar deta hai. < aur <= ko mix karna sab se aam off-by-one ghalti hai. Dry-run table mein har iteration ke liye ek row likhein, jis mein i ki value aur condition ka result ho. Examiners ko yeh bohat pasand hai.
